svg.aria-label: Worker 的全部 44 个类及其直接关系

g.title: WorkerRuntime → WorkerSettings: settings（注入）
WorkerRuntime → WorkerRootLock: root_lock（创建）
WorkerRuntime → WorkerExecution: executions[flow_id]；跨重连保留
WorkerRuntime → RepositoryWorkspaces: workspaces；所有 Flow 共用
WorkerRuntime → Gateway: gateway；路由当前 server 连接
WorkerRuntime → FileLinks: files；跨任务持久登记
WorkerRuntime → CodingAgent: _agents；每后端一个，编码 / 推理 / 历史 / 文件共用
WorkerRuntime → CodexAgent: 仅创建一个共享 Codex 后端实例
WorkerRuntime → AmpCodingAgent: 仅创建一个共享 Amp 后端实例
WorkerRuntime → ExecutionState: scan()；每个 Flow 创建一个状态对象
WorkerRuntime → WorkerExecutor: 每个 Flow 创建，注入 state、共享 Agent 与目录池
WorkerRuntime → HealthFile: _report_health() 创建
WorkerRuntime → WebSocketTransport: 每次连接创建 IO 适配器
WebSocketTransport → Connection: connection（注入）
WebSocketTransport → Transport: 结构化满足共享 IO 接口
WorkerRuntime → Session: 每次连接创建，与 Gateway 共同清理
WorkerRuntime → WorkerStateCallbacks: 每次连接创建与关闭
WorkerRuntime → WorkerBusinessCallbacks: 每次连接创建与关闭
WorkerRuntime → WorkerFileCallbacks: 每次连接创建与关闭
WorkerRuntime → WorkerInferenceCallbacks: 每次连接创建与关闭；直接注入共享 agent.start、既有 inference_path 与 trusted-host ready
WorkerRuntime → WorkerProtocolError: 拒绝无效 execution / workspace 身份
WorkerRuntime → link_history(): read_history()：读取后登记出站文件链接
Gateway → Session: 经 Registration 持有连接；不拥有编码执行
Gateway → Dispatcher: serve() 创建一个串行路由器
Gateway → SessionCallbacks: serve(*callbacks) 调用 bind(routes)
Session → Transport: _transport；仅通信 IO
WorkerStateCallbacks → Session: session；握手 / 心跳 / 结果与停止凭据
WorkerStateCallbacks → Dispatcher: bind() 保存 routes；注册控制路由与钩子
WorkerStateCallbacks → WorkerRuntime: runtime；调用执行与目录池入口
WorkerStateCallbacks → WorkerExecution: 经 Runtime 定位；start / resume / stop / ACK
WorkerStateCallbacks → RepositoryWorkspaces: 经 Runtime 查询 / provision / 报告库存
WorkerStateCallbacks → RepositoryProvisionError: 捕获容量拒绝并回复 code
WorkerStateCallbacks → WorkerProtocolError: 拒绝无权或不匹配的协议操作
WorkerStateCallbacks → WorkerInferenceCallbacks: inference_callbacks；取消与心跳
WorkerStateCallbacks → SessionCallbacks: bind(routes) 结构化满足
WorkerBusinessCallbacks → Session: session；出站工具与历史回复
WorkerBusinessCallbacks → Dispatcher: routes；借用调用的回复关联
WorkerBusinessCallbacks → WorkerRuntime: runtime；读取历史与遍历执行
WorkerBusinessCallbacks → WorkerExecution: 临时借用执行；不拥有 Task / Future
WorkerBusinessCallbacks → PendingToolCall: pending[job_id]；共享同一 Future
WorkerBusinessCallbacks → WorkerProtocolError: 拒绝工具回复身份不匹配
WorkerBusinessCallbacks → SessionCallbacks: bind(routes) 结构化满足
WorkerFileCallbacks → Session: session；异步文件读取完成后发送
WorkerFileCallbacks → WorkerRuntime: 注入绑定的 resolve_file 回调；返回既有 Agent + source
WorkerFileCallbacks → CodingAgent: 直接 await agent.read_file(source, root=worker_root)
WorkerFileCallbacks → Dispatcher: bind() 注册读取路由与 prepare 钩子
WorkerFileCallbacks → SessionCallbacks: bind(routes) 结构化满足
WorkerExecution → WorkerExecutor: executor；直接持有具体执行器，拥有执行 Task 与取消 / join
WorkerExecution → ExecutionState: state；与该 Flow 的 Executor 共用
WorkerExecution → PendingToolCall: _tool_calls；原调用者 Future 队列
WorkerExecution → WorkerProtocolError: 所有权校验失败 / 取消工具调用
WorkerExecution → FlowToolCallError: 工具 future.set_exception()
FlowToolCallError → WorkerProtocolError: 继承
WorkerExecution → FlowToolCaller: tool_caller=self；不依赖当前连接
WorkerExecutor → CodingAgent: code_agent；注入 Runtime 共享实例，与同后端历史查询共用
CodexAgent → CodingAgent: 继承 start / resume / _execute 及本地文件实现；原生执行实现 _run
AmpCodingAgent → CodingAgent: 继承共享执行生命周期；实现 _run，扩展附件 URL，保留本地文件默认实现
WorkerExecutor → ExecutionState: state；与 WorkerExecution 共用
WorkerExecutor → RepositoryWorkspaces: workspaces；Runtime 创建并注入
WorkerExecutor → FlowToolCaller: execute() 的临时入参
WorkerExecutor → WorkerMCP: INITIAL 与有限修正共用的 async with
WorkerExecutor → VcsVerificationError: 抛出 / 捕获 → 失败结果
WorkerExecutor → CodingExecutionContext: 创建每轮 GitHub / MCP 能力
WorkerExecutor → CodingExecutionResult: 读取 Agent 结果并核验业务输出 / VCS
WorkerMCP → FlowToolCaller: caller（本轮引用）
WorkerMCP → _EmbeddedServer: _server（创建）
ExecutionState → ExecutionRecord: load / _write；不持有历史 reader
ExecutionState → ExecutionStateError: 证据或恢复身份无效时抛出
ExecutionState → JournalSelection: scan() 校验旧选择记录并迁移目录
ExecutionState → _LegacyRecord: 经 decode_journal() 兼容读取 v4
ExecutionState → WorkspaceBinding: bind_workspace() / verify_cleanup()
ExecutionRecord → _RecordFields: 继承公共字段与证据校验
_LegacyRecord → _RecordFields: 继承；覆写旧凭据字段
_LegacyRecord → ExecutionRecord: current() 显式投影为 v5
_RecordFields → ProtocolModel: 显式继承共享模型
JournalSelection → ProtocolModel: 显式继承共享模型
_RecordFields → WorkspaceBinding: workspace: 0..1（子类继承）
AmpHistory → _Snapshot: _cache[session_id]
RepositoryWorkspaces → WorkspaceManifest: 读写 workspace-pool.json
RepositoryWorkspaces → WorkspaceBinding: claim / lookup / release；校验 generation
RepositoryWorkspaces → WorkspaceSlot: 创建 / 更新槽位
RepositoryWorkspaces → InferenceWorkspace: initialize() 创建默认无仓库位置
RepositoryWorkspaces → RepositoryProvisionError: 容量不足时抛出
RepositoryWorkspaces → VcsVerificationError: 抛出 / 捕获
RepositoryProvisionError → VcsVerificationError: 继承；增加 ProvisionError code
WorkspaceManifest → WorkspaceSlot: slots: 0..*
WorkspaceManifest → InferenceWorkspace: inference: 0..1
WorkspaceSlot → WorkspaceBinding: binding: 0..1
CodexAgent → CodexHistory: _history（每个 Agent 自建）
CodexAgent → codex._OutputLimit: 本模块 read() 抛出 / _run() 捕获
AmpCodingAgent → AmpHistory: _history（每个 Agent 自建）
AmpCodingAgent → AmpProcessResult: run_process() 返回；_outcome() 解析
AmpCodingAgent → amp._OutputLimit: run_process() 的 read() 抛出 / 外层捕获
AmpCodingAgent → AmpAttachment: register_file / read_file 校验 URL 身份并调用 read(root)
AmpHistory → AmpCodingAgent: 静态 run_process() 执行只读 thread export
AmpHistory → AmpProcessResult: 检查 export 的状态与有界 stdout
CodingAgent → CodingExecutionContext: start / resume 的可空 context
CodingAgent → CodingExecutionResult: _execute 返回；填充 backend、检查最终字节 / 严格 JSON、归一总超时等失败
CodingAgent → HistoryQuery: read_history(query)
CodingAgent → HistoryPage: read_history() 返回
CodingAgent → LocalFile: 本地默认实现校验 path / device / inode 并有界读取
CodingAgent → FileLinks: register_file(source, files)；登记 backend + 不透明 source
CodexHistory → HistoryQuery: query() 读取游标与 session
CodexHistory → HistoryPage: 构造原生 JSONL 的公开分页
AmpHistory → HistoryQuery: query() 校验公开投影的游标
AmpHistory → HistoryPage: 构造原生 export 的公开分页
link_history() → HistoryPage: 深拷贝；只改写出站 Markdown 目标
link_history() → AmpAttachment: 识别白名单附件对象；name 用于显示，url URI 始终由 Amp 登记，不受历史来源影响
link_history() → WorkerRuntime: register(source, owner) 回调绑定 Runtime.register_file；Path 沿用历史 backend，附件 URI 固定 amp
AmpAttachment → AmpCodingAgent: 静态 run_process() 下载；限制时间 / 输出 / 文件
WorkerInferenceCallbacks → CodingAgent: start 是既有 agent.start 的绑定方法；既有 cwd、context=None、模型 / effort / 字节 / 总超时按调用传入
WorkerInferenceCallbacks → CodingExecutionResult: 接收 start 结果，原样装入 AgentResult；执行失败另用 InferenceFailure
WorkerInferenceCallbacks → Session: session；观察推理完成并发送结果
WorkerInferenceCallbacks → Dispatcher: bind() 注册 worker.start（AgentStart → AgentResult）
WorkerInferenceCallbacks → SessionCallbacks: bind(routes) 结构化满足
BubAgent → CodingAgent: 包外显式子类；继承 start / resume / _execute，_run 调用无工具 SDK 子进程；不支持 resume / 历史
update_worker() → InstalledPackage: 经 installed_package() 读取
update_worker() → UpdateError: 抛出 / 捕获
